en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2371 - Muhammad ibn Humran narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) from his father (as), who said: "I was with Ali ibn al-Husayn (as) in the Sacred Sanctuary, and he saw me troubling the swallows.
Imam (as) said: 'O my son, do not kill them and do not harm them, for they do not harm anything.'"
